label: Bible Study
prompt: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; _____, and it shall be opened unto you:
verse: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
note: Ask, seek, knock — the verbs escalate, and the initials happen to spell ASK.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great _____.
verse: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
note: Three words to the sea — 'Peace, be still' — and the storm remembers who made it.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Pride goeth before _____, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verse: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
note: Everyone quotes 'pride goeth before a fall,' but the KJV says destruction first — the fall comes in the second half.

label: Deep Water
prompt: It is good for a man that he bear the _____ in his youth.
verse: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
note: The yoke is an ox harness, not an egg — Jeremiah says discipline learned young sits lighter.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a _____.
verse: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
note: Paul's fear after preaching to others: being 'a castaway' — disqualified, washed up on shore.
